mechanism.claim: After a completed four-hour BTC range, a second four-hour auction that strictly breaks one boundary, subsequently retests that same boundary, and still closes outside it demonstrates accepted price discovery rather than a transient stop run. Follow the accepted breakout for eight hours during elevated realized variation.
mechanism.side: long for upper-boundary break-retest-acceptance and short for lower-boundary break-retest-acceptance; ambiguous dual patterns are ineligible
mechanism.why_distinct: Donchian rules test a terminal range escape, range traversal orders absolute extrema, cumulative VWAP recross counts anchor crossings, and close-location rules ignore a prior boundary. HVRBRAR requires within-confirmation temporal order of strict break, later boundary retest, and final outside acceptance against a disjoint prior four-hour range, with no volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-asset, fitted outcome, prior event, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the full completed eight-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three daily break-retest-acceptance clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.prior_range: first 240 one-minute rows [D-8h,D-4h), high=max high and low=min low
features.upper_pattern: first confirmation minute with high>prior high exists; a strictly later minute has low<=prior high; final confirmation close>prior high
features.lower_pattern: first confirmation minute with low<prior low exists; a strictly later minute has high>=prior low; final confirmation close<prior low
features.ambiguity: exactly one of upper_pattern and lower_pattern must hold
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns across [D-8h,D)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligible_state: exactly one accepted breakout pattern and variation gate pass

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: ordered boundary break, later retest, and terminal acceptance against a disjoint prior range

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no range, break, retest, acceptance, ambiguity, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
